home_court.home_win_rate_note: measured, not fitted: it is the share of captured finals the home team won
home_court.implied_hca_formula: z(home_win_rate) x sd(home margin), with z the inverse normal CDF; this is the margin that would produce exactly the measured home-win rate on the measured spread
home_court.caveat: n = 22 finals. The 95% Wilson interval for the home-win rate is printed on the page; at this n it is wide and the pin should be revisited as the log grows.
home_court.source: data/app/results_feed.json + data/rounds/2026-11-16/results.json, both transcribed from official game books / the official scoreboard

estimator_b.name: efficiency-based, possessions x rating difference
estimator_b.inputs: official advanced page OffRtg / DefRtg / Pace

error_summary.baseline: a constant predicted margin equal to the pinned home-court value
error_summary.note: each game is predicted from strictly earlier games only

luck.method: r_i = outcome_i - p_i for every game a team played; z = sum(r_i) / (pooled_sd x sqrt(n)), with the sd POOLED across the league because a single team's 1-2 games cannot estimate their own spread
luck.caveat: a team with fewer than 4 captured games is reported with its z but flagged is_z_meaningful=false; the strategy gate treats a non-meaningful z as a block, not as a pass.

market_prior.why: No licensed closing-line feed is connected. The blend weight would be exp(-logloss_model) / (exp(-logloss_model) + exp(-logloss_closing)) with both log-losses measured out of sample; with no closing line there is no second log-loss to measure, so the field is left null rather than filled with a guess.
market_prior.formula: blended = w * model + (1 - w) * closing, w = exp(-LL_model) / (exp(-LL_model) + exp(-LL_closing))
